router.whenToUse: Classify every new Paseo task and recommend one configured Paseo profile.

ordinary.whenToUse: Mechanical edits, bug fixes, features within an existing design, tests, and reviews. Use when the brief does not establish a need for deep redesign.

deep.whenToUse: New architecture or data-model design, difficult concurrency or security reasoning, or a bug still unexplained after investigation.
